about: Hardware twins. If you play a real synth or drum machine, the other jammers hear a software twin from the same family: the twin instrument (the unit's own 'twin' if it names one, else its family's), loaded with the preset for your patch type, with this unit's character settings on top. Twins are family resemblances, not emulations. 'character' values override the patch-type preset; 'types' lists the patch types that suit the unit (first is the default). Add a unit by adding an entry. 'osc' and 'filter' describe the circuit (vco, dco, va, wavetable, sample, fm; ladder, ota, ssm, cem, sem, diode, ms20, steiner, arp, svf, digital, none) and refine the twin ranking: a twin or library instrument that declares matching traits ranks higher. Each family lists candidate twins with a rough match score; a unit's own 'twin' is ranked first.
